newsitem.title: UK: PRESS DIGEST - London Evening Standard - Oct 1.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - London Evening Standard - Oct 1.

text.p: Prepared for Reuters by The Broadcast Monitoring Company
THE 50 MLN STG MAN OVER THE SHOP

Nicholas Roditi, a secretive fund manager who operates from a small office above a shop in Hampstead High Street, has been revealed as Britain's highest paid man, with an income last year of 50 million stg.
MERILL TAKES TOP US UNDERWRITING SPOT
Merrill Lynch has topped the US underwriters' rankings for the third quarter, according to a report by Securities Data.
PENSIONS BY PHONE IS GA'S NEW CALLING
General Accident is to launch a service selling pensions over the phone, despite concern among consumer groups that pensions are not suitable products for telephone marketing.
FUNERAL GIANTS IN A LIFE AND DEATH STRUGGLE

Rose Hill cemetery and funeral home, near Los Angeles, was taken over by Canada's Loewen Group last week for $277 million as part of a campaign to fend off an unwelcome $3.1 billion bid from the industry's leading player, Service Corporation International of Houston.
CONFLICT SHOOTS HOLES IN ISRAEL INVESTMENT HOPES
The current crisis in relations between Palestine and Israel has dealt a severe blow to Israel's hopes of attracting global investment.
